decision.observed_event: Your rapier hits the dealer. The dealer is hurt. The wound bleeds bright and red, and the white paint smears with it. Roll initiative.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren stabs the dealer through the hand.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl is hurt and his act cracks with the blood.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets the blood give away the act and starts the fight fast.

public_brief.objective: Survive the blade and rally his crew.
public_brief.tactic: Clutch the wound and order the others to attack.
public_brief.visible_cue: Blood runs bright red through the white paint on his hand.
public_brief.reply_to: I put my rapier through his hand.
public_brief.kit_focus: Show the hit and the ordinary red blood through the paint, then call initiative.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, tight, no humor: keep the combat beat fast and physical

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The rapier flicks out and through the back of the dealer's hand, pinning nothing but finding meat. He snatches it back with a hiss. The wound bleeds bright and red, ordinary red, and the white paint on his knuckles smears pink with it. Chairs go over all around the table.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: You will pay for that in blood, madam, every drop of it! Up, all of you, up! Do you sit there gawking while a guest carves up your host? Take her, and take her purse with her!
